messages:
lina: Quick ask from Accounts: customer wants more explicit 'pin expiry negotiation' language and a sandbox they can run before a forced migration. Need concrete acceptance gates and a simple timeline for sales to show.

ash: I propose three pin tiers: 90-day short, 180-day standard, 365-day enterprise. Short = auto-roll after TTL; enterprise = manual opt-out only. Must include paid migration option.

tom: Acceptance gates: (1) perf p95 <= 200ms @<=1024 tokens, (2) task metric delta <= 1% vs pinned baseline on customer golden set, (3) zero high-severity safety hits on fuzzer + spot checks.

daria: Sandbox idea: isolated sandbox with same quant/profile hooks. Offer two modes: quick (24h, limited qps) and pilot (30d, VPC peering). Customer uploads golden_prompts.tar.gz. Provide docker harness to run pre/post evals.

ash: Canary schedule for migrations: phases 1%, 10%, 100% with 48h between checks. Abort if quality drop >1% or error-rate x2 or latency increase >20%.

legal: Need plain-language migration notice: default 90d before forced migration. Also need refund triggers: outage >30m or customer-labeled metric regression >2% -> credit formula in appendix.

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-7001: pin-expiry-playbook (assignee: lina).

lina: Owners & timeline: spec draft (lina, Wed EOD), sandbox infra outline (tom, Thu), benchmark harness + sample prompts (daria, Wed), refund wording (legal, Fri).

ash: I'll sketch a short 1-page summary for Sales: bullets for pin types, TL;DR of gates, how sandbox works, and migration SLA options.

lina: Great. We'll review Mon 11am. Keep the playbook concise so Sales can include it in SOWs.
